## [FX-GST-CEMENT-OLD] GST rate on cement before GST 2.0
section: 
effective_from: 2017-07-01
effective_to: 2025-09-21
topic: gst_rates
verified: partial

Before GST 2.0, from July 2017 up to 21 September 2025, cement was taxed under GST at 28 percent. This was one of the highest GST slabs and applied to ordinary portland cement sold by dealers.

## [FX-GST-CEMENT-NEW] GST rate on cement after GST 2.0 (from 22 September 2025)
section: 
effective_from: 2025-09-22
effective_to:
topic: gst_rates
verified: partial

From 22 September 2025, under GST 2.0 rate rationalisation, cement is taxed at 18 percent GST instead of 28 percent. The change was notified by the GST Council and applies to all sales made on or after that date.

## [FX-MAP-80C] Mapping — old section 80C to new Act
section: 80C
law: mapping
doc_type: mapping
effective_from: 2026-04-01
effective_to:
topic: mapping
verified: partial

The deduction that was in section 80C of the Income-tax Act, 1961 continues in the Income-tax Act, 2025 under a new section number in the deductions chapter, for the old regime only. Users who search for 80C should read the new provision when dealing with Tax Year 2026-27.
